data.body:
ADEVX-137 closed cleanly with no force override, landed in PR navapbc/agentic-development-platform#25 and merged into v0.3.1 at bafe579.

Fixed the silent transition failure in scripts/import_rebar_tickets.py. The bare except rebar.RebarError discarded the error, the ticket still counted as created, and main returned 0 unconditionally, so a Jira ticket that was closed or in_progress could land at open while the run reported success. Finished work would then reappear through rebar ready. ImportReport now carries failed_transitions, main prints one line per failure plus a count, and returns 1 when any failed.

Checked the live pilot store before fixing. It was not affected, all 6 tickets held their intended status. The defect was latent.

Verified the T4 plan-review advisory rather than asserting it away. The only caller is tasks.py line 131, the operator-invoked inv import-rebar-tickets, which runs through invoke's c.run with default warn=False, so a non-zero exit raises UnexpectedExit. No .github workflow references the script.

All 3 new tests were proven to fail without the fix. Full suite 1549 passed, 19 skipped, 0 failed.

ADEVX-136 was merged into v0.3.1 at 046de15 first, because a branch forked from v0.3.1 without the tracked [tool.rebar.llm] table would have left the close gate on the broken Anthropic defaults.

Process note carried forward. A plan review signed at the base ref goes stale once the file-impact paths are implemented, so the flow is review at base, implement, re-run the review with --gate-ref at the branch head, then claim and close with REBAR_GATE_REF set to that same head.
